title: Luscious Molten Moroccan Flour Tagine
description: Indulge in this rich, umami-rich, molten Moroccan dish featuring a surprise ingredient - flour, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, perfect for raw food enthusiasts.
instructions: Preheat your ttukbaegi earthenware pot to 425F (220C).
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, almond milk, chicken broth, and tomato paste until smooth.
Heat the vegetable oil in the preheated pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Pour the flour mixture into the pot and stir to combine.
Add the ras el hanout spice blend, ground cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
